name: Sydney
summary: Spend a day around the harbour, a day at the beaches and a day in the Blue Mountains. Ferries are transport and sightseeing at once.
seasonNote: Summer (December to February) is hot and busy; New Year's Eve is the price peak. Winter is mild.
arrival: The airport train reaches the centre in about 15 minutes.
gettingAround: Tap a contactless card on trains, ferries, light rail and buses; fares are capped daily.
cashTip: Cards are used for everything; tipping is optional.
foodTip: Try flat whites and brunch, fish and chips by the water, Sydney rock oysters and modern Asian cooking.
buyTip: Aboriginal art from ethical, artist-owned galleries; sun-care and surf brands.
baseArea: The Rocks, the CBD, Surry Hills or Bondi
reviewSummary: These places are an editorial shortlist of the sights and food the city is best known for. Popularity numbers come from Wikipedia readership, and from Google Maps once it is connected; places without a number are kept unranked.

items.name: Sydney Opera House
items.summary: The sail-roofed performing arts centre on the harbour, open for tours and shows.
items.expect: Free to walk around; tours and performances need tickets.
items.tip: Take the one-hour tour, or book any performance to see inside.

items.name: Sydney Harbour Bridge
items.summary: The steel arch 'Coathanger', which you can walk across for free or climb with a guide.
items.expect: BridgeClimb is expensive and takes about three hours.
items.tip: Walk the free footpath and climb the Pylon Lookout for a cheap high view.

items.expect: Exposed to sun and busy on weekend mornings.
items.tip: Start at the Bondi Icebergs pool and swim at Bronte on the way.

items.name: Blue Mountains
items.summary: Sandstone cliffs, eucalyptus valleys and the Three Sisters rock formation, two hours west by train.
items.expect: Cooler than the city; mist can hide the views.
items.tip: Take an early train to Katoomba and walk part of the cliff-top track.

items.name: Sydney Fish Market
items.summary: A working fish market with counters selling oysters, sashimi and fish and chips.
items.expect: Very busy at weekend lunchtimes; the market has moved to a new building nearby.
items.tip: Go on a weekday and eat outside by the water.
